summary: Iteration 49 (BIBLIA 0.9 final cleanup). Frontend only, web preview at 390x844, 360x640 and 800x1000. Node tests 42/42 pass. tsc --noEmit is clean. ESLint in app/ shows 14 React-compiler advisories in app/way/* plus 1 import/first warning in app/living/[id].tsx; the other ESLint findings are in scripts/cmd-guard tooling. Requested flows that PASS: (1) Commentary filters are collapsed by default and the toggle reads 'Filter · 5 von 5 Autoren ▾'. Expanding shows 5 tradition-filter-* chips and 5 source-filter-* chips; collapsing again works. (2) Author filter at Röm 8,28: switching chips off one at a time gives labels 4/5 … 0/5 and the last step shows commentary-empty. That state persists after reload, as does 'one on' (Streitenberger only). Turning all back on gives 5/5 and 3 cards. The tradition toggle off/on also works. (3) Compare view: cards are stacked full width at 390 (w=340) and 360 (w=310), with no horizontal overflow; at 800 they sit side by side (3×245). (4) Kroeker 1Mo 1,1 and Ps 1,1 have no £ ® | \ © characters and no 'Men- schen'-style splits. (5) Ansorg: Neh 8,1, Neh 13,1, Dan 11,1, Am 2,1, Mt 3,1, Mt 10,1, Mt 28,1, Spr 9,1 and 2Kö 4,1 each show the matching -kN chapter entry with the correct verse range. Dan 4,10 shows ansorg-27-4-1 (4,1–37). There are 0 duplicate ids. (6) Full backup download and restore round trip works; an invalid file is rejected. (7) Regression: cross-refs preview and the 'Im Zusammenhang lesen' jump, /station/tora-1-1, /library, /settings, /lexicon, /timeline, /study/sources and /way all fine. There were 0 page errors and 0 console errors. Kroeker OCR is still incomplete outside the two test verses.

ui_bugs.issue: 2,213 U+FFFD characters in 206/742 Rieger entries (ä/ö/ü/ß lost, the typical Latin-1/UTF-8 decode problem). Visible e.g. at Röm 8,28: 'Text: R�mer 8,28-39'. Top tokens: da� 152, f�r 69, �ber 65, R�mer 45, mu� 39. This is present in both backend/data/commentaries/rieger.json and the offline bundle.

The 1Mo 1,1 visible text still has OCR noise: 'Hebr. 1, if.' (should be 1, 1f.), 'Erz leuchtung' (should be Erleuchtung), stray ' j ' before 'Aber' and 'So', and a letter-spaced heading 'W a s sind'. Across all Kroeker entries: 81 '£' remain in 67 entries (pattern 'f£.' such as '20f£.', 'i£.', which the ocr() regex does not cover because it only handles digit+£), 6 '$' for ß ('fliel$t'), 82 ', if.'/', iff.' reference artifacts, 58 stray ' j ' tokens, and 15 glued word runs (e.g. kroeker-33-1-1 'DieEinwohnerschaftvon Marothgrämt sichnach').

kroeker-19-1-1 is only 1,197 characters long. It starts mid-sentence ('und ihn nicht sucht, verliert sich ins Verderben.'), and the heading 'Psalm 1' appears twice. The beginning of the text is missing in the source data.

The photo count uses Object.keys(b.photos).length, not the number of files actually written. A backup with '../evil.jpg' and '.hidden' (both rejected by the allowlist) still reports '3 Fotos'; on web, 0 are written. Reference: frontend/src/lib/fullBackup.ts:88

rca_of_issue: Rieger: the source text was decoded with the wrong charset during import, so non-ASCII letters became U+FFFD. This cannot be recovered from the current JSON alone; the original module has to be re-imported. Kroeker: the ocr() regexes only cover a digit directly followed by '£'. The common OCR form 'f£.' (from 'ff.'), and 'i' read for '1' in 'if.', are not handled.
